open_points.subject: record_flow_output
open_points.text: - InputSource discriminated union on field 'source_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): RecordedSource (source_kind='recorded'), ListElementSource (source_kind='list_element'), MappedListSource (source_kind='mapped_list'); a value of InputSource is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and InputSource itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - record_flow_output: [BEHAVIOR] A RecordedSource MUST answer a StoredValuesRef with its ref's value_id and port the source's port, the flow output port's name; a MappedListSource MUST publish its list's StoredValue with put_value_bytes and write it in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange through record_change under the given actor before answering its ref; it checks nothing, since a flow output holds the value its edge delivered and is of value carriage (A05 rule 7). A RefusedError or StoreInternalError from put_value_bytes and a failed record_change are broken invariants raised as StoreInternalError.
open_points.question: Must record_flow_output's source type exclude ListElementSource, or must its behavior specify how a ListElementSource is recorded?

open_points.subject: record_flow_output RecordedSource
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - record_flow_output: [BEHAVIOR] A RecordedSource MUST answer a StoredValuesRef with its ref's value_id and port the source's port, the flow output port's name; a MappedListSource MUST publish its list's StoredValue with put_value_bytes and write it in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange through record_change under the given actor before answering its ref; it checks nothing, since a flow output holds the value its edge delivered and is of value carriage (A05 rule 7). A RefusedError or StoreInternalError from put_value_bytes and a failed record_change are broken invariants raised as StoreInternalError.
open_points.question: Must a RecordedSource passed to record_flow_output be restricted to a StoredValuesRef, or must the behavior handle PortRef variants that have no value_id?

set_aside.subject: assemble_mapped_lists
set_aside.text: - assemble_mapped_lists: [BEHAVIOR] MUST build, for each MappedList in the order given, the list its elements' outputs make in element order, and write and publish nothing: a value list is one StoredValue whose bytes are canonical_bytes of the JSON array text made of the elements' stored bytes — each read with read_value_bytes — in element order, separated by commas, between [ and ], whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) as items, of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for the elements' StoredValues — read through read_records with one RecordsById naming their value_ids —, its value_digest content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent; a file list is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements' SpooledFilesRefs.
set_aside.other_text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: Must FileFactsRef be removed from the PortRef values allowed in MappedList.elements, or must assemble_mapped_lists define how a FileFactsRef contributes stored bytes or spooled-file keys?

set_aside.subject: deliver_input
set_aside.text: - deliver_input: [BEHAVIOR] MUST resolve the source to exactly one of two results before the check: a written StoredValue together with its canonical bytes, or a SpooledFilesRef; each result is checked and returned where it is resolved, with the StoredValue, the bytes and the files it was resolved with, so no value that might still be None reaches fit_port_value, a JsonCandidate or a BytesContent.
